Name: Jezaniah the Maachathite
Summary: Jezaniah the Maachathite was a captain of the forces who came with his men to Gedaliah at Mizpah after Jerusalem fell. He is a different man from Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah.
KeyStory: Jezaniah the Maachathite came with his men to Gedaliah at Mizpah and heard the governor's counsel to serve Babylon and live.
LifeLesson: After ruin, the first faithful step is to gather where God's appointed governor is.
